note: UXF-09 recorded swipe streams (off-screen qa-galley harness, 2026-10-08). wheel: DOM wheel events [t ms, deltaX, deltaY, owned 0/1, mods 0/1, deltaMode] as the page saw them; native: NSEvent scroll-wheel events [t ms, phase, momentumPhase, scrollingDeltaX, scrollingDeltaY, inverted 0/1] as an NSEvent local monitor saw them. Phases are NSEventPhase bits (1 began, 4 changed, 8 ended, 16 cancelled, 32 may-begin). open = sidebar open before the first swipe; exp = the toggles expected (true = shown).
